brief: Two distinct flocks of streamlined, arrowhead particles circulate smoothly across a dark slate-gray canvas. One flock gleams in bright amber and copper hues, while the other shines in vivid cyan and electric azure. Each flock exhibits cohesive flocking behavior, aligning with and maintaining proximity to its own members. When the two opposing swarms draw close to one another, an invisible repulsive force pushes them apart, causing them to part like opposing currents in a river, curving gracefully around the boundary before reforming. The continuous, fluid dance of mutual avoidance unfolds endlessly on its own without requiring any viewer interaction.
